name: plane-hero
title: Plane Hero
description: A centred headline over a dotted WebGL globe. City chips ride the sphere on CSS anchor positioning and fade as they rotate away, while great-circle arcs redraw on a stagger with a 3D plane at each peak, yawed to its own flight bearing. Plane model: chroma3d on Sketchfab (https://sketchfab.com/vendol21). Globe by cobe, vendored under MIT.
